versions.content: When DEM calls J1939Dcm_DemTriggerOnDTCStatus , the DM01 message shall be transmitted (additionally to the regular periodic transmission) for the corresponding ‘node’ of the reported ‘DemClient’ for all configured channels, except J1939Dcm_DemTriggerOnDTCStatus for the same DTC is triggered more than once per second. The separate DM01 buffer shall be used .
